# 2brain

> A typed knowledge engine over markdown — notes claim a type, link each other with `[[wiki-links]]` and
> carry addressable `^block-ids` — plus the MCP server agents read and write it through. One Rust binary,
> one language on the request path, files as the source of truth. Status: alpha; the on-disk format still
> carries its pre-fork `au.engine.*` naming and is migrating in steps.

This file maps the repository for an agent. Each link is a document written to be read whole, not a page
of a website.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the project is and is not, quickstart, the MCP surface, development gates.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): the map of all 84 documents in four kinds, and what each kind may claim.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): the system in one page — invariants, crate layers, the request
  path, the write contract, and the 52 tools grouped by what they answer.
- [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md): why the project exists, what exists today, five stages with checkable exit
  criteria, the order of what comes next, and which work may run in parallel.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to work *in* this repository — the three layers, the live-system rules, the
  gates that must stay green, the docs split between design and operations.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed, including the changes that were measured and rejected.

## Use the server

- [tb-mcp-rs/skills/2brain/SKILL.md](tb-mcp-rs/skills/2brain/SKILL.md): the tool ladder, the result
  envelope, the read-then-write loop, the recovery path for an unclear mutation.
- [tb-mcp-rs/skills/2brain/references/tool-map.md](tb-mcp-rs/skills/2brain/references/tool-map.md): every
  tool with its arguments, generated from the running binary.
- [tb-mcp-rs/docs/roadmap.md](tb-mcp-rs/docs/roadmap.md): the adapter's closed completion record — what it set
  out to do and the evidence for each item; not a plan.

## The contracts

- [tb-engine/crates/tb-engine/WIRE.md](tb-engine/crates/tb-engine/WIRE.md): the engine wire protocol, verb
  by verb, with the schema version and the payload of each read.
- [tb-type-system/](tb-type-system/): the type-system contract the vault format depends on.
- [docs/naming.md](docs/naming.md): which names are the product, which are contracts, and which are
  mid-migration.
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): the monorepo's license map (Sustainable Use 1.0 for the engine and server, MIT
  for the content repositories).

## Evidence

- [tb-mcp-rs/docs/verification.md](tb-mcp-rs/docs/verification.md): every property this repository claims,
  the command that re-measures it, and the date it was last measured.
- [docs/trajectory.md](docs/trajectory.md): the dated log — what landed, what it cost, and what was measured and
  reverted. It records history; [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md) is the plan.
- [docs/ideas.md](docs/ideas.md): every idea that is not in the queue, with its status and the measurement that
  decided it — so a refused idea is not re-proposed every month.
- [docs/research/](docs/research/): the measurements behind the ranking, the payload modes, the judge layer,
  the tier-C migration, and the engine-to-server path.
- [tools/cards/metrics.json](tools/cards/metrics.json): the numbers on the README cards, each with the
  command that produced it.

## Optional

- [docs/architecture-plan.md](docs/architecture-plan.md): the architecture as it was planned, kept for the
  reasoning rather than as a description of today.
- [docs/internal/](docs/internal/): operations for one host — swap runbooks, client wiring, run logs. Not
  needed to understand the system; a second machine would rewrite this first.
- [upstream/](upstream/): the upstream project's own documentation, kept verbatim as an archive.
